fields.subject: SqlParameterCollectionExtensions
fields.trigger: a caller invokes a table-valued helper with SqlDataRecord rows, models, keyed models, or virtual compound keys containing a shard identifier
fields.response: append one Structured input parameter whose row values follow the supplied sequence and whose keyed overloads place the shard identifier before record and successive child identifiers; when the supplied collection is null or yields zero rows, still append the parameter and set its Value to a null reference (never System.DBNull.Value and never an empty SqlDataRecord enumeration, both of which Microsoft.Data.SqlClient rejects client-side), which SQL Server receives as a table with no rows; the raw SqlDataRecord overload normalizes only a null reference or a collection whose Count is observably zero and passes any other sequence through without enumerating it
fields.postcondition: the parameter name is @-prefixed and the supplied collection is returned; an empty or null source never throws and never omits the parameter
